title: JSW Group to invest heavily in Bengal cement and power sector
summary: JSW Group to invest heavily in Bengal cement and power sector
body_markdown:
**India:** The JSW Group will invest close to US$5.3bn in Bengal in the power, power equipment, port and cement sectors, its chairman Sajjan Jindal said after meeting chief minister Suvendu Adhikari in Calcutta on 4 November 2026. Jindal said US$4.3bn was for power, while another US$1.1bn was for other areas.


JSW, one of the country’s largest industrial groups, is a long-time investor in Bengal, where it operates a cement plant and a steel unit. It is also in the process of building a power plant at Salboni in West Midnapore district.
